name: God Being The Same
overview: Scripture reveals that God’s nature is unchanging and eternal, as He declares in Malachi 3:6, "I am the LORD, I change not." His covenant promises remain firm and unaltered, exemplified in Psalms 89:34. From everlasting to everlasting, God’s existence transcends time, as affirmed in Psalms 90:2 and Psalms 102:24, underscoring His eternal presence. Furthermore, the eternal Word, Jesus Christ, who was with God in the beginning and is God (John 1:1), offers the gift of eternal life, highlighting the consistency of God's redemptive plan revealed through Christ (Romans 6:23).
